errors.text_span: The chart clearly illustrates that “Our Joint Framework” achieves significantly lower runtime compared to all tested LLMs, with DeepSeek being the slowest at 365 seconds and LLaMA the fastest among LLMs at 172 seconds.
errors.evidence: The prompt instructs the model to avoid making inferences, comparisons, or drawing conclusions, and to use neutral language. This sentence violates these rules by making direct comparisons ("lower runtime compared to all tested LLMs"), using evaluative language ("clearly illustrates," "significantly lower"), and interpreting the data by labeling models as "slowest" and "fastest" rather than neutrally stating the values of the tallest and shortest bars.
